maya (People Ops): Morning @alex 1 1 1 quick Q: you mentioned you need to add your adult brother as a dependent due to a permanent disability. We can process a midyear QLE for dependent eligibility extension, but carriers require specific documentation. What do you have so far?
alex lee: Hi Maya 1 I have the SSDI award letter, a doctor9s letter describing the disability and that he is unable to self-support, and proof of shared residence. Do carriers accept the SSDI award as primary proof?
maya (People Ops): That9s a good start. Most carriers accept the Social Security Disability Award letter plus a physician statement confirming incapacity. We also need proof that he's financially dependent (e.g., shared lease or bank statement) if he's over the plan9s dependent age. Please upload docs within 30 days of the QLE date to avoid losing retro coverage.
samir khan: Heads-up @alex 1 payroll: if we can verify within 30 days we can apply premiums retroactive to the QLE. If verification takes longer, deductions may start next cycle and retro reimbursements are harder. Also note tax implications if you plan to claim him as a dependent.
alex lee: Understood. Quick question: the SSDI letter is a scanned PDF with part of the SSN redacted by his lawyer. Will that block enrollment?
maya (People Ops): Redaction is fine for the publicly viewable doc; however carriers usually require the full SSN for enrollment. You can either submit the unredacted doc via the secure upload (Benefits > Upload > Sensitive) or provide the SSN in a secure note to benefits@redwood-inference.com. Mark the upload as "contains sensitive info".
benefits-bot: @alex lee Steps to upload (UI flow): 1) Go to Benefits -> Manage Dependents -> Add Dependent. 2) Select "Adult Dependent - Disability". 3) Upload files: SSDI_award.pdf, physician_statement.pdf, proof_shared_residence.pdf. 4) Toggle "Contains sensitive info" if including SSN. Example command snippet: ```Benefits -> Add Dependent -> Category: Adult Disabled -> Upload -> Confirm```
alex lee: Uploaded SSDI_award_redacted.pdf and physician_note_202602.pdf to the portal and just submitted the SSN through the secure form. Also cc9d my brother's POA email for contact.
hr-portal-bot: Documents received. Case ID D-2026-772 created. Verification queue ETA 2-4 business days. If carrier needs more, benefits will reach out with required doc list.
maya (People Ops): Thanks @alex 1 once verification completes we'll confirm the effective date and any payroll retro adjustments. If the carrier denies, we'll work through appeal/alternative documentation. Ping me if you need a note for tax advising. :thumbsup:
